# Purpose

This notebook creates analysis-ready yarn and MiniSpin processing datasets for the
2022 qFL-Chr.25 end-use evaluation.

For the 2022 end-use experiment, machine-harvested cotton was microginned and the
same lint lot was then subsampled for fiber testing and miniature spinning. The
validated 2022 sample key is therefore used as the authoritative link between field
sample, genotype, NIL pair, qFL-Chr.25 status, fiber ID, Micro ID, and MiniSpin run.

The raw yarn workbook contains measurements at several experimental levels:

1. **field-sample/lint-lot level** — one record per 2022 sample (`n = 92`);
2. **package/bobbin level** — two yarn packages per sample (`n = 184`);
3. **single-end technical-replicate level** — individual tensile breaks within
   packages (expected `n = 3680`, 20 breaks × 2 packages × 92 samples).

The primary manuscript yarn analysis will use the field-sample level as the
biological experimental unit. Package-level records are retained for confirmation
and sensitivity analyses. Individual tensile breaks are retained for technical QC
and are not treated as independent biological replicates.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
project_root <- normalizePath(
  "C:/Users/sjw23099/Desktop/End-Use Evaluation",
  winslash = "/",
  mustWork = TRUE
)

knitr::opts_knit$set(

source(
  file.path(

    "04_code",
    "00_setup.R"
  ),

knitr::opts_chunk$set(

```

# 1. Check required packages

```{r check-packages}
required_packages <- c(
  "dplyr",
  "tidyr",
  "purrr",
  "readr",
  "readxl",
  "tibble",
  "stringr",
  "janitor"
)

missing_packages <- required_packages[
  !vapply(
    required_packages,
    requireNamespace,
    logical(1),
    quietly = TRUE
  )
]

if (length(missing_packages) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Install the following packages before continuing: ",
    paste(
      missing_packages,
      collapse = ", "
    )
  )
}
```

# 2. Create output folders

```{r create-output-folders}
yarn_output_root <- file.path(
  project_root,
  "05_results",
  "yarn_cleaning"
)

yarn_audit_dir <- file.path(
  yarn_output_root,
  "audits"
)

purrr::walk(
  c(
    yarn_output_root,
    yarn_audit_dir
  ),
  dir.create,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)
```

# 3. Locate required input files

```{r locate-input-files}
sample_key_file <- file.path(
  paths$data_processed,
  "sample_key_2022.csv"
)

yarn_matches <- list.files(
  paths$data_raw,
  pattern = "^UGA MSL Yarn Results.*\\.xlsx$",
  full.names = TRUE,
  ignore.case = TRUE
)

if (!file.exists(sample_key_file)) {
  stop(
    "The validated 2022 sample key was not found:\n",
    sample_key_file
  )
}

if (length(yarn_matches) == 0) {
  stop(
    "No UGA MSL Yarn Results workbook was found in:\n",
    paths$data_raw
  )
}

if (length(yarn_matches) > 1) {
  stop(
    "More than one UGA MSL Yarn Results workbook was found.\n",
    "Keep only the intended raw yarn workbook in 02_data_raw, or ",
    "update the file-selection rule.\n\n",
    paste(
      basename(yarn_matches),
      collapse = "\n"
    )
  )
}

yarn_file <- yarn_matches[[1]]

input_file_audit <- tibble::tibble(
  file_type = c(
    "Validated sample key",
    "Raw yarn workbook"
  ),
  filename = c(
    basename(sample_key_file),
    basename(yarn_file)
  ),
  exists = c(
    file.exists(sample_key_file),
    file.exists(yarn_file)
  )
)

input_file_audit
```

# 4. Validate required workbook sheets

```{r validate-yarn-sheets}
required_yarn_sheets <- c(
  "ID Cross-Ref",
  "Skein Avg",
  "Skein Ind",
  "Average Yarn Report",
  "Overall Yarn Report",
  "Tensorapid Indiv",
  "MSL Processing Data"
)

available_yarn_sheets <- readxl::excel_sheets(
  yarn_file
)

missing_yarn_sheets <- setdiff(
  required_yarn_sheets,
  available_yarn_sheets
)

if (length(missing_yarn_sheets) > 0) {
  stop(
    "The yarn workbook is missing these required sheets: ",
    paste(
      missing_yarn_sheets,
      collapse = ", "
    )
  )
}

sheet_audit <- tibble::tibble(
  required_sheet = required_yarn_sheets,
  present = required_yarn_sheets %in%
    available_yarn_sheets
)

sheet_audit
```

# 5. Import and validate the master sample key

```{r import-sample-key}
sample_key <- readr::read_csv(
  sample_key_file,
  show_col_types = FALSE,
  col_types = readr::cols(
    field_sample_id = readr::col_character(),
    genotype = readr::col_character(),
    background = readr::col_character(),
    nil_set = readr::col_character(),
    qtl_status = readr::col_character(),
    material_type = readr::col_character(),
    field_rep = readr::col_character(),
    plot = readr::col_character(),
    micro_id = readr::col_character(),
    fiber_id = readr::col_character(),
    minispin_run = readr::col_character(),
    .default = readr::col_guess()
  )
) |>
  janitor::clean_names() |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    field_sample_id = stringr::str_trim(
      as.character(
        field_sample_id
      )
    ),
    micro_id = stringr::str_trim(
      as.character(
        micro_id
      )
    ),
    fiber_id = stringr::str_trim(
      as.character(
        fiber_id
      )
    ),
    minispin_run = stringr::str_trim(
      as.character(
        minispin_run
      )
    )
  )

sample_key_audit <- sample_key |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    rows = dplyr::n(),
    unique_field_samples =
      dplyr::n_distinct(
        field_sample_id
      ),
    unique_micro_ids =
      dplyr::n_distinct(
        micro_id
      ),
    unique_fiber_ids =
      dplyr::n_distinct(
        fiber_id
      ),
    unique_minispin_runs =
      dplyr::n_distinct(
        minispin_run
      )
  )

sample_key_audit

if (nrow(sample_key) != 92) {
  stop(
    "The validated sample key does not contain 92 rows."
  )
}

if (
  anyDuplicated(sample_key$field_sample_id) > 0 ||
  anyDuplicated(sample_key$micro_id) > 0 ||
  anyDuplicated(sample_key$fiber_id) > 0 ||
  anyDuplicated(sample_key$minispin_run) > 0
) {
  stop(
    "Duplicate identifiers were detected in the validated sample key."
  )
}
```

# 6. Import the yarn cross-reference table

```{r import-cross-reference}
cross_ref_raw <- readxl::read_excel(
  yarn_file,
  sheet = "ID Cross-Ref",
  col_types = "text"
) |>
  janitor::clean_names()

required_cross_ref_columns <- c(
  "sample",
  "name",
  "micro_id",
  "plot",
  "fiber_id",
  "run_number",
  "hvi_length",
  "ratch"
)

missing_cross_ref_columns <- setdiff(
  required_cross_ref_columns,
  names(cross_ref_raw)
)

if (length(missing_cross_ref_columns) > 0) {
  stop(
    "ID Cross-Ref is missing columns: ",
    paste(
      missing_cross_ref_columns,
      collapse = ", "
    )
  )
}

cross_ref <- cross_ref_raw |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    field_sample_id =
      stringr::str_trim(
        as.character(
          sample
        )
      ),
    workbook_name =
      stringr::str_squish(
        as.character(
          name
        )
      ),
    workbook_micro_id =
      stringr::str_trim(
        as.character(
          micro_id
        )
      ),
    workbook_plot =
      stringr::str_trim(
        as.character(
          plot
        )
      ),
    workbook_fiber_id =
      stringr::str_trim(
        as.character(
          fiber_id
        )
      ),
    workbook_minispin_run =
      stringr::str_trim(
        as.character(
          run_number
        )
      ),
    workbook_hvi_length =
      suppressWarnings(
        as.numeric(
          hvi_length
        )
      ),
    workbook_ratch =
      suppressWarnings(
        as.integer(
          ratch
        )
      )
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(
      field_sample_id
    ),
    field_sample_id != ""
  )

cross_ref_audit <- tibble::tibble(
  check = c(
    "Rows",
    "Unique field samples",
    "Unique micro IDs",
    "Unique MiniSpin runs",
    "Ratch 3 samples",
    "Ratch 4 samples",
    "Ratch 5 samples",
    "Missing ratch"
  ),
  result = c(
    nrow(
      cross_ref
    ),
    dplyr::n_distinct(
      cross_ref$field_sample_id
    ),
    dplyr::n_distinct(
      cross_ref$workbook_micro_id
    ),
    dplyr::n_distinct(
      cross_ref$workbook_minispin_run
    ),
    sum(
      cross_ref$workbook_ratch == 3,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    sum(
      cross_ref$workbook_ratch == 4,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    sum(
      cross_ref$workbook_ratch == 5,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    sum(
      is.na(
        cross_ref$workbook_ratch
      )
    )
  )
)

cross_ref_audit
```

# 7. Verify cross-reference IDs against the validated sample key

The sample key remains authoritative. The workbook cross-reference is used only as
an independent consistency check and as the source of the ratch setting.

```{r validate-cross-reference}
cross_ref_check <- sample_key |>
  dplyr::select(
    field_sample_id,
    micro_id,
    fiber_id,
    minispin_run,
    ratch
  ) |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    cross_ref,
    by = "field_sample_id"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    micro_id_match =
      micro_id == workbook_micro_id,
    fiber_id_match =
      fiber_id == workbook_fiber_id,
    minispin_run_match =
      minispin_run == workbook_minispin_run,
    ratch_match =
      suppressWarnings(as.integer(ratch)) == workbook_ratch
  )

cross_ref_identifier_audit <- cross_ref_check |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    unmatched_cross_ref_rows =
      sum(
        is.na(
          workbook_minispin_run
        )
      ),
    micro_id_mismatches =
      sum(
        !micro_id_match,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    fiber_id_mismatches =
      sum(
        !fiber_id_match,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    minispin_run_mismatches =
      sum(
        !minispin_run_match,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    ratch_mismatches =
      sum(
        !ratch_match,
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
  )

cross_ref_identifier_audit

if (
  cross_ref_identifier_audit$unmatched_cross_ref_rows > 0 ||
  cross_ref_identifier_audit$micro_id_mismatches > 0 ||
  cross_ref_identifier_audit$fiber_id_mismatches > 0 ||
  cross_ref_identifier_audit$minispin_run_mismatches > 0 ||
  cross_ref_identifier_audit$ratch_mismatches > 0
) {
  stop(
    "The yarn cross-reference table does not match the validated sample key."
  )
}
```

# 8. Create authoritative yarn-sample metadata

```{r create-yarn-sample-metadata}
yarn_sample_metadata <- sample_key |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    cross_ref |>
      dplyr::select(
        field_sample_id,
        workbook_name,
        workbook_hvi_length
      ),
    by = "field_sample_id"
  )

if (any(is.na(yarn_sample_metadata$ratch))) {
  stop(
    "One or more samples are missing a ratch setting."
  )
}

dplyr::glimpse(
  yarn_sample_metadata
)
```

# 9. Import sample-level skein averages

The `Skein Avg` worksheet contains one averaged record per MiniSpin run.

```{r import-skein-averages}
skein_avg_raw <- readxl::read_excel(
  yarn_file,
  sheet = "Skein Avg"
) |>
  janitor::clean_names()

skein_avg <- skein_avg_raw |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    minispin_run =
      stringr::str_trim(
        as.character(
          fiber_id
        )
      ),
    micro_id =
      stringr::str_trim(
        as.character(
          micro_id
        )
      ),
    skein_breaking_strength_n =
      suppressWarnings(
        as.numeric(
          breaking_strength_n
        )
      ),
    skein_extension_mm =
      suppressWarnings(
        as.numeric(
          extension_mm
        )
      ),
    skein_weight_g =
      suppressWarnings(
        as.numeric(
          weight_g
        )
      ),
    actual_yarn_count_ne =
      suppressWarnings(
        as.numeric(
          count_ne
        )
      ),
    skein_mn_tex =
      suppressWarnings(
        as.numeric(
          m_n_tex
        )
      ),
    skein_elongation_pct =
      suppressWarnings(
        as.numeric(
          elong_percent
        )
      )
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(
    minispin_run %in%
      yarn_sample_metadata$minispin_run
  )

skein_avg_audit <- skein_avg |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    rows = dplyr::n(),
    unique_runs =
      dplyr::n_distinct(
        minispin_run
      ),
    unique_micro_ids =
      dplyr::n_distinct(
        micro_id
      ),
    missing_actual_yarn_count =
      sum(
        is.na(
          actual_yarn_count_ne
        )
      )
  )

skein_avg_audit

if (
  nrow(skein_avg) != 92 ||
  dplyr::n_distinct(
    skein_avg$minispin_run
  ) != 92
) {
  stop(
    "Skein Avg did not resolve to exactly 92 unique MiniSpin runs."
  )
}
```

# 10. Import individual skein bobbin records

The `Skein Ind` worksheet contains two bobbins plus a calculated average for each
MiniSpin run. Only bobbins 1 and 2 are retained here.

```{r import-individual-skein-bobbins}
skein_ind_raw <- readxl::read_excel(
  yarn_file,
  sheet = "Skein Ind"
) |>
  janitor::clean_names() |>
  tidyr::fill(
    fiber_id,
    micro_id,
    .direction = "down"
  )

skein_bobbin <- skein_ind_raw |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    minispin_run =
      stringr::str_trim(
        as.character(
          fiber_id
        )
      ),
    micro_id =
      stringr::str_trim(
        as.character(
          micro_id
        )
      ),
    package =
      suppressWarnings(
        as.integer(
          bobbin_number
        )
      )
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(
    minispin_run %in%
      yarn_sample_metadata$minispin_run,
    package %in% c(
      1L,
      2L
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    minispin_run,
    micro_id,
    package,
    skein_breaking_strength_n =
      suppressWarnings(
        as.numeric(
          breaking_strength_n
        )
      ),
    skein_extension_mm =
      suppressWarnings(
        as.numeric(
          extension_mm
        )
      ),
    skein_weight_g =
      suppressWarnings(
        as.numeric(
          weight_g
        )
      ),
    bobbin_yarn_count_ne =
      suppressWarnings(
        as.numeric(
          ne
        )
      ),
    skein_mn_tex =
      suppressWarnings(
        as.numeric(
          m_n_tex
        )
      ),
    skein_elongation_pct =
      suppressWarnings(
        as.numeric(
          elong_percent
        )
      )
  )

skein_bobbin_audit <- skein_bobbin |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    rows = dplyr::n(),
    unique_runs =
      dplyr::n_distinct(
        minispin_run
      ),
    unique_run_package =
      dplyr::n_distinct(
        interaction(
          minispin_run,
          package
        )
      )
  )

skein_bobbin_audit

if (
  nrow(skein_bobbin) != 184 ||
  anyDuplicated(
    skein_bobbin[
      c(
        "minispin_run",
        "package"
      )
    ]
  ) > 0
) {
  stop(
    "Skein Ind did not resolve to 184 unique run-package records."
  )
}
```

# 11. Import sample-level single-end and evenness averages

The `Average Yarn Report` has three header rows and one intentionally blank spacer
column. To avoid fragile dependence on how `janitor::clean_names()` interprets labels
such as `CVm % [1yd]`, the data columns are assigned explicit names by position.

```{r import-average-yarn-report}
average_yarn_raw <- readxl::read_excel(
  yarn_file,
  sheet = "Average Yarn Report",
  skip = 3,
  col_names = FALSE
)

if (ncol(average_yarn_raw) != 16) {
  stop(
    "Average Yarn Report did not contain the expected 16 columns."
  )
}

names(average_yarn_raw) <- c(
  "micro_id",
  "run_number",
  "b_force_n",
  "tenacity_cn_tex",
  "elo_percent",
  "work_to_break_n_cm",
  "blank_1",
  "cv_percent",
  "cvm_1yd_pct",
  "cvm_3yd_pct",
  "thin_50",
  "thick_50",
  "neps_200",
  "neps_280",
  "hairiness",
  "sh"
)

average_yarn <- average_yarn_raw |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    micro_id =
      stringr::str_trim(
        as.character(
          micro_id
        )
      ),
    minispin_run =
      stringr::str_trim(
        as.character(
          run_number
        )
      ),
    single_end_break_force_n =
      suppressWarnings(
        as.numeric(
          b_force_n
        )
      ),
    yarn_tenacity_cn_tex =
      suppressWarnings(
        as.numeric(
          tenacity_cn_tex
        )
      ),
    yarn_elongation_pct =
      suppressWarnings(
        as.numeric(
          elo_percent
        )
      ),
    yarn_work_to_break_n_cm =
      suppressWarnings(
        as.numeric(
          work_to_break_n_cm
        )
      ),
    yarn_evenness_cv_pct =
      suppressWarnings(
        as.numeric(
          cv_percent
        )
      ),
    yarn_cvm_1yd_pct =
      suppressWarnings(
        as.numeric(
          cvm_1yd_pct
        )
      ),
    yarn_cvm_3yd_pct =
      suppressWarnings(
        as.numeric(
          cvm_3yd_pct
        )
      ),
    yarn_thin_50 =
      suppressWarnings(
        as.numeric(
          thin_50
        )
      ),
    yarn_thick_50 =
      suppressWarnings(
        as.numeric(
          thick_50
        )
      ),
    yarn_neps_200 =
      suppressWarnings(
        as.numeric(
          neps_200
        )
      ),
    yarn_neps_280 =
      suppressWarnings(
        as.numeric(
          neps_280
        )
      ),
    yarn_hairiness =
      suppressWarnings(
        as.numeric(
          hairiness
        )
      ),
    yarn_sh =
      suppressWarnings(
        as.numeric(
          sh
        )
      )
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(
    minispin_run %in%
      yarn_sample_metadata$minispin_run
  )

average_yarn_audit <- average_yarn |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    rows = dplyr::n(),
    unique_runs =
      dplyr::n_distinct(
        minispin_run
      ),
    unique_micro_ids =
      dplyr::n_distinct(
        micro_id
      )
  )

average_yarn_audit

if (
  nrow(average_yarn) != 92 ||
  dplyr::n_distinct(
    average_yarn$minispin_run
  ) != 92
) {
  stop(
    "Average Yarn Report did not resolve to exactly 92 unique MiniSpin runs."
  )
}
```

# 12. Import package-level yarn measurements

The `Overall Yarn Report` contains two package-level records for each MiniSpin run.
Its columns are assigned explicitly by position to avoid name-cleaning ambiguity.

One known source-workbook labeling error is present in this sheet: the second
package for Micro ID `4122` is labeled as MiniSpin run `M23072`, whereas the
validated sample key identifies Micro ID `4122` as `M23071`. To preserve the raw
workbook unchanged and make the correction reproducible, this notebook retains the
raw run label for auditing but assigns the authoritative MiniSpin run by `micro_id`
from the validated sample key.

```{r import-package-level-yarn}
package_yarn_raw <- readxl::read_excel(
  yarn_file,
  sheet = "Overall Yarn Report",
  skip = 3,
  col_names = FALSE
)

if (ncol(package_yarn_raw) != 20) {
  stop(
    "Overall Yarn Report did not contain the expected 20 columns."
  )
}

names(package_yarn_raw) <- c(
  "micro_id",
  "run_number",
  "package",
  "break_strength_n",
  "tenacity_cn_tex",
  "elo_percent",
  "work_to_break_n_cm",
  "blank_1",
  "cvm_percent",
  "cvm_1yd_pct",
  "cvm_3yd_pct",
  "thin_40",
  "thin_50",
  "thick_35",
  "thick_50",
  "neps_140",
  "neps_200",
  "neps_280",
  "hairiness",
  "sh"
)

package_yarn_prepared <- package_yarn_raw |>
  tidyr::fill(
    micro_id,
    run_number,
    .direction = "down"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    micro_id =
      stringr::str_trim(
        as.character(
          micro_id
        )
      ),
    raw_minispin_run =
      stringr::str_trim(
        as.character(
          run_number
        )
      ),
    package =
      suppressWarnings(
        as.integer(
          package
        )
      )
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(
    micro_id %in%
      yarn_sample_metadata$micro_id,
    package %in% c(
      1L,
      2L
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    yarn_sample_metadata |>
      dplyr::select(
        micro_id,
        minispin_run
      ),
    by = "micro_id"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    run_number_match =
      raw_minispin_run == minispin_run
  )

# Audit any raw workbook run labels that disagree with the validated sample key.
package_run_corrections <- package_yarn_prepared |>
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(
      raw_minispin_run
    ),
    !is.na(
      minispin_run
    ),
    !run_number_match
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(
    micro_id,
    package,
    raw_minispin_run,
    corrected_minispin_run = minispin_run
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(
    micro_id,
    package
  )

package_run_corrections

package_run_correction_audit <- tibble::tibble(
  check = c(
    "Raw package rows retained",
    "Run-label mismatches corrected",
    "Unmatched Micro IDs after authoritative join"
  ),
  result = c(
    nrow(
      package_yarn_prepared
    ),
    nrow(
      package_run_corrections
    ),
    sum(
      is.na(
        package_yarn_prepared$minispin_run
      )
    )
  )
)

package_run_correction_audit

if (
  any(
    is.na(
      package_yarn_prepared$minispin_run
    )
  )
) {
  stop(
    "One or more Overall Yarn Report records could not be linked to ",
    "an authoritative MiniSpin run using Micro ID."
  )
}

package_yarn <- package_yarn_prepared |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    minispin_run,
    micro_id,
    package,
    raw_minispin_run,
    run_number_corrected =
      !run_number_match,
    single_end_break_force_n =
      suppressWarnings(
        as.numeric(
          break_strength_n
        )
      ),
    yarn_tenacity_cn_tex =
      suppressWarnings(
        as.numeric(
          tenacity_cn_tex
        )
      ),
    yarn_elongation_pct =
      suppressWarnings(
        as.numeric(
          elo_percent
        )
      ),
    yarn_work_to_break_n_cm =
      suppressWarnings(
        as.numeric(
          work_to_break_n_cm
        )
      ),
    yarn_evenness_cv_pct =
      suppressWarnings(
        as.numeric(
          cvm_percent
        )
      ),
    yarn_cvm_1yd_pct =
      suppressWarnings(
        as.numeric(
          cvm_1yd_pct
        )
      ),
    yarn_cvm_3yd_pct =
      suppressWarnings(
        as.numeric(
          cvm_3yd_pct
        )
      ),
    yarn_thin_40 =
      suppressWarnings(
        as.numeric(
          thin_40
        )
      ),
    yarn_thin_50 =
      suppressWarnings(
        as.numeric(
          thin_50
        )
      ),
    yarn_thick_35 =
      suppressWarnings(
        as.numeric(
          thick_35
        )
      ),
    yarn_thick_50 =
      suppressWarnings(
        as.numeric(
          thick_50
        )
      ),
    yarn_neps_140 =
      suppressWarnings(
        as.numeric(
          neps_140
        )
      ),
    yarn_neps_200 =
      suppressWarnings(
        as.numeric(
          neps_200
        )
      ),
    yarn_neps_280 =
      suppressWarnings(
        as.numeric(
          neps_280
        )
      ),
    yarn_hairiness =
      suppressWarnings(
        as.numeric(
          hairiness
        )
      ),
    yarn_sh =
      suppressWarnings(
        as.numeric(
          sh
        )
      )
  )

package_yarn_audit <- package_yarn |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    rows = dplyr::n(),
    unique_runs =
      dplyr::n_distinct(
        minispin_run
      ),
    unique_run_package =
      dplyr::n_distinct(
        interaction(
          minispin_run,
          package
        )
      ),
    corrected_run_labels =
      sum(
        run_number_corrected,
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
  )

package_yarn_audit

if (
  nrow(package_yarn) != 184 ||
  dplyr::n_distinct(
    package_yarn$minispin_run
  ) != 92 ||
  anyDuplicated(
    package_yarn[
      c(
        "minispin_run",
        "package"
      )
    ]
  ) > 0
) {
  stop(
    "Overall Yarn Report did not resolve to 184 unique run-package records ",
    "after authoritative MiniSpin-run assignment."
  )
}
```

# 13. Import individual single-end tensile breaks

Each package is expected to contain 20 single-end tensile breaks. These are
technical replicates and are retained for QC and optional hierarchical sensitivity
analysis.

```{r import-individual-breaks}
single_end_raw <- readxl::read_excel(
  yarn_file,
  sheet = "Tensorapid Indiv",
  skip = 3,
  col_names = FALSE
)

if (ncol(single_end_raw) != 8) {
  stop(
    "Tensorapid Indiv did not contain the expected 8 columns."
  )
}

names(single_end_raw) <- c(
  "micro_id",
  "package",
  "technical_rep",
  "time_to_break",
  "break_strength_n",
  "elo_percent",
  "tenacity_cn_tex",
  "work_to_break_n_cm"
)

single_end_breaks <- single_end_raw |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    micro_id =
      stringr::str_trim(
        as.character(
          micro_id
        )
      ),
    package =
      suppressWarnings(
        as.integer(
          package
        )
      ),
    technical_rep =
      suppressWarnings(
        as.integer(
          technical_rep
        )
      )
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(
    micro_id %in%
      yarn_sample_metadata$micro_id,
    package %in% c(
      1L,
      2L
    ),
    technical_rep >= 1L,
    technical_rep <= 20L
  ) |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    micro_id,
    package,
    technical_rep,
    time_to_break =
      suppressWarnings(
        as.numeric(
          time_to_break
        )
      ),
    single_end_break_force_n =
      suppressWarnings(
        as.numeric(
          break_strength_n
        )
      ),
    yarn_elongation_pct =
      suppressWarnings(
        as.numeric(
          elo_percent
        )
      ),
    yarn_tenacity_cn_tex =
      suppressWarnings(
        as.numeric(
          tenacity_cn_tex
        )
      ),
    yarn_work_to_break_n_cm =
      suppressWarnings(
        as.numeric(
          work_to_break_n_cm
        )
      )
  )

break_count_audit <- single_end_breaks |>
  dplyr::count(
    micro_id,
    package,
    name = "n_breaks"
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(
    micro_id,
    package
  )

break_count_summary <- break_count_audit |>
  dplyr::count(
    n_breaks,
    name = "n_packages"
  )

break_count_summary

if (
  nrow(single_end_breaks) != 3680 ||
  any(
    break_count_audit$n_breaks != 20
  )
) {
  warning(
    "The individual-break dataset does not contain exactly ",
    "20 breaks for every package. Review the break-count audit."
  )
}
```

# 14. Import MiniSpin processing data

The `MSL Processing Data` worksheet contains a title row above the actual headers,
so the sheet is imported with `skip = 1`.

```{r import-processing-data}
processing_raw <- readxl::read_excel(
  yarn_file,
  sheet = "MSL Processing Data",
  skip = 1
) |>
  janitor::clean_names()

processing <- processing_raw |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    micro_id =
      stringr::str_trim(
        as.character(
          fiber_id
        )
      ),
    minispin_run =
      stringr::str_trim(
        as.character(
          process_id
        )
      ),
    card_temp_f =
      suppressWarnings(
        as.numeric(
          card_temp_f
        )
      ),
    card_rh_pct =
      suppressWarnings(
        as.numeric(
          card_rh_percent
        )
      ),
    card_in_g =
      suppressWarnings(
        as.numeric(
          card_in_g
        )
      ),
    card_out_g =
      suppressWarnings(
        as.numeric(
          card_out_g
        )
      ),
    card_waste_g =
      suppressWarnings(
        as.numeric(
          waste_g
        )
      ),
    card_waste_pct =
      suppressWarnings(
        as.numeric(
          waste_percent
        )
      ),
    card_web_gr_yd =
      suppressWarnings(
        as.numeric(
          card_web_gr_yd
        )
      ),
    drawing_1_g =
      suppressWarnings(
        as.numeric(
          d1_g
        )
      ),
    drawing_1_gr_yd =
      suppressWarnings(
        as.numeric(
          d1_gr_yd
        )
      ),
    drawing_2_g =
      suppressWarnings(
        as.numeric(
          d2_g
        )
      ),
    drawing_2_gr_yd =
      suppressWarnings(
        as.numeric(
          d2_gr_yd
        )
      ),
    drawing_3_g =
      suppressWarnings(
        as.numeric(
          d3_g
        )
      ),
    drawing_3_gr_yd =
      suppressWarnings(
        as.numeric(
          d3_gr_yd
        )
      ),
    spin_temp_f =
      suppressWarnings(
        as.numeric(
          spin_temp_f
        )
      ),
    spin_rh_pct =
      suppressWarnings(
        as.numeric(
          spin_rh_percent
        )
      ),
    nominal_yarn_count_ne =
      suppressWarnings(
        as.numeric(
          nom_count
        )
      )
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(
    minispin_run %in%
      yarn_sample_metadata$minispin_run
  )

processing_audit <- processing |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    rows = dplyr::n(),
    unique_runs =
      dplyr::n_distinct(
        minispin_run
      ),
    missing_card_waste_pct =
      sum(
        is.na(
          card_waste_pct
        )
      ),
    missing_nominal_count =
      sum(
        is.na(
          nominal_yarn_count_ne
        )
      )
  )

processing_audit

if (
  nrow(processing) != 92 ||
  dplyr::n_distinct(
    processing$minispin_run
  ) != 92
) {
  stop(
    "MSL Processing Data did not resolve to exactly 92 unique MiniSpin runs."
  )
}
```

# 15. Verify IDs across all sample-level yarn tables

```{r sample-level-id-audit}
sample_level_id_audit <- yarn_sample_metadata |>
  dplyr::select(
    field_sample_id,
    micro_id,
    minispin_run
  ) |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    skein_avg |>
      dplyr::select(
        minispin_run,
        skein_micro_id = micro_id
      ),
    by = "minispin_run"
  ) |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    average_yarn |>
      dplyr::select(
        minispin_run,
        average_yarn_micro_id = micro_id
      ),
    by = "minispin_run"
  ) |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    processing |>
      dplyr::select(
        minispin_run,
        processing_micro_id = micro_id
      ),
    by = "minispin_run"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    skein_micro_match =
      micro_id == skein_micro_id,
    average_yarn_micro_match =
      micro_id == average_yarn_micro_id,
    processing_micro_match =
      micro_id == processing_micro_id
  )

sample_level_id_summary <- sample_level_id_audit |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    missing_skein_avg =
      sum(
        is.na(
          skein_micro_id
        )
      ),
    missing_average_yarn =
      sum(
        is.na(
          average_yarn_micro_id
        )
      ),
    missing_processing =
      sum(
        is.na(
          processing_micro_id
        )
      ),
    skein_micro_mismatch =
      sum(
        !skein_micro_match,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    average_yarn_micro_mismatch =
      sum(
        !average_yarn_micro_match,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    processing_micro_mismatch =
      sum(
        !processing_micro_match,
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
  )

sample_level_id_summary

if (
  any(
    unlist(
      sample_level_id_summary
    ) != 0
  )
) {
  stop(
    "One or more yarn tables failed the MiniSpin/Micro-ID linkage audit."
  )
}
```

# 16. Create the final sample-level yarn dataset

This is the primary analysis-ready yarn dataset. There is one row per biological
field sample/lint lot.

```{r create-sample-level-dataset}
yarn_sample_clean <- yarn_sample_metadata |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    skein_avg |>
      dplyr::select(
        -micro_id
      ),
    by = "minispin_run"
  ) |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    average_yarn |>
      dplyr::select(
        -micro_id
      ),
    by = "minispin_run"
  ) |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    processing |>
      dplyr::select(
        -micro_id
      ),
    by = "minispin_run"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    actual_minus_nominal_count_ne =
      actual_yarn_count_ne -
      nominal_yarn_count_ne,
    absolute_count_deviation_ne =
      abs(
        actual_minus_nominal_count_ne
      )
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(
    field_sample_id
  )

dplyr::glimpse(
  yarn_sample_clean
)

if (
  nrow(yarn_sample_clean) != 92 ||
  anyDuplicated(
    yarn_sample_clean$field_sample_id
  ) > 0
) {
  stop(
    "The final sample-level yarn dataset is not 92 unique field samples."
  )
}
```

# 17. Create the final package-level yarn dataset

Skein bobbin measurements and package-level Uster/UTR4 measurements are combined
using MiniSpin run and package number.

```{r create-package-level-dataset}
yarn_package_clean <- package_yarn |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    skein_bobbin,
    by = c(
      "minispin_run",
      "micro_id",
      "package"
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    yarn_sample_metadata,
    by = c(
      "minispin_run",
      "micro_id"
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(
    field_sample_id,
    package
  )

dplyr::glimpse(
  yarn_package_clean
)

if (
  nrow(yarn_package_clean) != 184 ||
  anyDuplicated(
    yarn_package_clean[
      c(
        "field_sample_id",
        "package"
      )
    ]
  ) > 0
) {
  stop(
    "The final package-level yarn dataset is not 184 unique sample-package records."
  )
}
```

# 18. Attach sample metadata to the individual-break dataset

```{r create-break-level-dataset}
yarn_single_end_breaks_clean <- single_end_breaks |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    yarn_sample_metadata,
    by = "micro_id"
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(
    field_sample_id,
    package,
    technical_rep
  )

unmatched_breaks <- yarn_single_end_breaks_clean |>
  dplyr::filter(
    is.na(
      field_sample_id
    )
  )

if (nrow(unmatched_breaks) > 0) {
  stop(
    "One or more individual tensile breaks could not be linked to the sample key."
  )
}
```

# 19. Check that sample averages reproduce the two-package averages

This audit confirms that the sample-level `Average Yarn Report` values are
consistent with the arithmetic means of the two package-level records in the
`Overall Yarn Report`.

The package-level yarn variables retain their original cleaned names after the
join because the skein-bobbin table contains distinct `skein_*` variables. No
`.x`/`.y` suffixes are therefore expected for the Uster/UTR4 package traits.

```{r verify-package-averages}
package_mean_check <- yarn_package_clean |>
  dplyr::group_by(
    field_sample_id,
    minispin_run
  ) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    pkg_mean_break_force =
      mean(
        single_end_break_force_n,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    pkg_mean_tenacity =
      mean(
        yarn_tenacity_cn_tex,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    pkg_mean_elongation =
      mean(
        yarn_elongation_pct,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    pkg_mean_work_to_break =
      mean(
        yarn_work_to_break_n_cm,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    pkg_mean_evenness =
      mean(
        yarn_evenness_cv_pct,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    pkg_mean_thin50 =
      mean(
        yarn_thin_50,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    pkg_mean_thick50 =
      mean(
        yarn_thick_50,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    pkg_mean_neps200 =
      mean(
        yarn_neps_200,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    pkg_mean_neps280 =
      mean(
        yarn_neps_280,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    pkg_mean_hairiness =
      mean(
        yarn_hairiness,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    yarn_sample_clean |>
      dplyr::select(
        field_sample_id,
        single_end_break_force_n,
        yarn_tenacity_cn_tex,
        yarn_elongation_pct,
        yarn_work_to_break_n_cm,
        yarn_evenness_cv_pct,
        yarn_thin_50,
        yarn_thick_50,
        yarn_neps_200,
        yarn_neps_280,
        yarn_hairiness
      ),
    by = "field_sample_id"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    diff_break_force =
      pkg_mean_break_force -
      single_end_break_force_n,
    diff_tenacity =
      pkg_mean_tenacity -
      yarn_tenacity_cn_tex,
    diff_elongation =
      pkg_mean_elongation -
      yarn_elongation_pct,
    diff_work_to_break =
      pkg_mean_work_to_break -
      yarn_work_to_break_n_cm,
    diff_evenness =
      pkg_mean_evenness -
      yarn_evenness_cv_pct,
    diff_thin50 =
      pkg_mean_thin50 -
      yarn_thin_50,
    diff_thick50 =
      pkg_mean_thick50 -
      yarn_thick_50,
    diff_neps200 =
      pkg_mean_neps200 -
      yarn_neps_200,
    diff_neps280 =
      pkg_mean_neps280 -
      yarn_neps_280,
    diff_hairiness =
      pkg_mean_hairiness -
      yarn_hairiness
  )

package_mean_difference_summary <- package_mean_check |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    max_abs_break_force_diff =
      max(
        abs(
          diff_break_force
        ),
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    max_abs_tenacity_diff =
      max(
        abs(
          diff_tenacity
        ),
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    max_abs_elongation_diff =
      max(
        abs(
          diff_elongation
        ),
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    max_abs_work_to_break_diff =
      max(
        abs(
          diff_work_to_break
        ),
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    max_abs_evenness_diff =
      max(
        abs(
          diff_evenness
        ),
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    max_abs_thin50_diff =
      max(
        abs(
          diff_thin50
        ),
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    max_abs_thick50_diff =
      max(
        abs(
          diff_thick50
        ),
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    max_abs_neps200_diff =
      max(
        abs(
          diff_neps200
        ),
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    max_abs_neps280_diff =
      max(
        abs(
          diff_neps280
        ),
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    max_abs_hairiness_diff =
      max(
        abs(
          diff_hairiness
        ),
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
  )

package_mean_difference_summary
```

# 20. Trait missingness audit

```{r trait-missingness-audit}
identifier_columns <- c(
  "field_sample_id",
  "genotype",
  "background",
  "nil_set",
  "qtl_status",
  "material_type",
  "field_rep",
  "plot",
  "micro_id",
  "fiber_id",
  "minispin_run",
  "workbook_name"
)

sample_trait_columns <- setdiff(
  names(
    yarn_sample_clean
  ),
  identifier_columns
)

yarn_sample_missingness <- yarn_sample_clean |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    dplyr::across(
      dplyr::all_of(
        sample_trait_columns
      ),
      ~ sum(
        is.na(
          .x
        )
      )
    )
  ) |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = dplyr::everything(),
    names_to = "variable",
    values_to = "missing_values"
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(
    dplyr::desc(
      missing_values
    ),
    variable
  )

yarn_sample_missingness
```

# 22. Final cleaning audit

```{r final-cleaning-audit}
final_cleaning_audit <- tibble::tibble(
  check = c(
    "Validated sample-key rows",
    "Cross-reference rows",
    "Sample-level skein rows",
    "Sample-level Average Yarn rows",
    "Processing rows",
    "Final sample-level rows",
    "Package-level rows",
    "Expected package-level rows",
    "Individual break rows",
    "Expected individual break rows",
    "Packages with non-20 break counts",
    "Unmatched sample-level yarn records",
    "Unmatched break records"
  ),

  result = c(
    nrow(
      sample_key
    ),
    nrow(
      cross_ref
    ),
    nrow(
      skein_avg
    ),
    nrow(
      average_yarn
    ),
    nrow(
      processing
    ),
    nrow(
      yarn_sample_clean
    ),
    nrow(
      yarn_package_clean
    ),
    184,
    nrow(
      yarn_single_end_breaks_clean
    ),
    3680,
    sum(
      break_count_audit$n_breaks != 20
    ),
    sum(
      unlist(
        sample_level_id_summary
      )
    ),
    nrow(
      unmatched_breaks
    )
  )
)

final_cleaning_audit
```
